main_measure.name: t of OLS slope of next-bar excess return on forecast, forecast > 0 bars, pooled
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= +2 (with forecast-weighted mean excess > 0) confirms; t <= -2 rejects; otherwise inconclusive; at least 500 bars with forecast > 0

supporting_check.name: forecast-weighted mean next-bar excess return over forecast > 0 bars, above 0

decided_by: The slope's t is +2 or more and the forecast-weighted mean next-bar excess return is above 0.
reading: Bars with forecast > 0 counted where the next bar's close exists in the same window; the coin's mean daily return is the mean of all its in-window next-bar returns over all windows; the slope t is the ordinary OLS t (slope / its standard error); the plan's 500-bar minimum, when unmet, is reported as not observable.
